messages:
ana_sales: Acme wants a concise POC page for USB delivery: signing, SBOM, upgrade cadence, hotfix SLA, and whether we bill on delivery or on applied install. Can we agree bullets?
lee_se: Two signing flows: (A) Redwood HSM-signed detached sig + root import, (B) Customer-side offline signing kit (we provide tool + verify step). Option B shifts liability; include waiver.
sam_ops: Ops checklist notes: chunk large model into parts (<=40GB/part), include per-file sha256 in manifest, provide resumable apply utility. Pre-apply snapshot + rollback token mandatory.
lee_se: Example verify cmds for runbook:
sha256sum -c redwood.manifest && openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.part1
./redwood-apply --bundle parts/ --verify --dry-run
ana_sales: Hotfix SLA ask: can we do signed emergency patch in 24h and same-day handoff to courier?
maria_legal: We can offer 24h signed artifact on enterprise SLA with expedited fee. Courier pickup is customer logistics; clause: Redwood not liable for transit delays and requires tamper-evident chain-of-custody acceptance. Also flag export-control for certain libs.
sam_ops: Upgrade cadence recommendation: quarterly full releases + monthly security deltas. Keep quantized model bundles stable between minors to avoid re-quantizing.
lee_se: Billing: prefer bundle-issuance billing or per-device maintenance (covers N deltas/month). Billing on "applied" is possible if customer runs redwood-apply-report and uploads signed receipt; otherwise bill on delivery.
ana_sales: Can someone drop a 1-page ops checklist + SOW bullets here by EOD? Acme needs this to finalize SOW.
pkg-bot: pkg-bot: ticket SALES-9001 created (deliverables: ops-checklist, SOW wording for two signing flows, expedited-fee table, SBOM packaging format).
maria_legal: I'll post contract snippets for both signing options and emergency modifier by EOD.
sam_ops: I'll post the ops checklist with timings (verify: ~5-15m per part, apply: 30-90m depending on model) in ~2h.
ana_sales: Thanks team — once drafts in I'll consolidate and send to Acme. :thumbsup:
